description: This file defines the CalculatorResults class, which provides methods to retrieve and verify calculator display results in a UI testing framework using Selenium and Appium for Windows applications.

classes.name: CalculatorResults
classes.description: Provides methods to interact with and verify calculator result display elements in UI tests.

methods.name: GetAoTCalculatorResultText
methods.description: Retrieves the 'Always on Top' calculator result text, removing narrator-specific prefix.

methods.name: GetCalculatorResultText
methods.description: Retrieves the main calculator result text, cleaning up narrator text.

methods.name: GetCalculatorExpressionText
methods.description: Retrieves the calculator expression text, removing narrator prefix.

methods.name: IsResultsDisplayPresent
methods.description: Asserts that the calculator result display element is present (not null).

methods.name: IsResultsExpressionClear
methods.description: Checks that the calculator expression is clear by inspecting the page source.
